metadata.description: Layer a: running coupling, smearing widths, smeared kernels and angular factors
metadata.float_format: shortest round-trip repr of IEEE-754 double (exact when parsed as float64); non-finite -> null
metadata.units: masses/energies GeV, r GeV^-1, p GeV

notes.tensor_kernel_smeared: GIModel.tensor_kernel_smeared_coulomb = G'/r - G'' with r clamped to max(r,1e-7)
notes.contact_kernel_smeared: GIModel.smeared_contact_kernel = sum_k alpha_k * delta_{tau_k}(r), delta_s(r)=s^3/pi^1.5 exp(-s^2 r^2)
notes.fine_structure_radial_kernels: GIModel.fine_structure_radial_kernels(params,masses,r); vector_ii/scalar_ii use the equal-mass pair (m_i,m_i); kernels clamp r to max(r,1e-8) before G'/r, S'/r
notes.running: unsmeared running-coupling forms (not on the production path; diagnostics)
